title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Adelphi University
description: Verifiable late-night dining and snack destinations near the Garden City campus, including on-campus staples and local 24-hour favorites.

cards.title: The Eatery at Post Hall
cards.subtitle: On-Campus Late Night Grill
cards.notes: Visit the lower level of Post Hall for late-night grill favorites like burgers and chicken fingers, typically serving until midnight daily.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus destination for late-night hot meals and social gathering at Post Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Eatery at Post Hall offers late-night menus and is open for late-night ordering until 12:00 midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily for late-night grill service.

cards.title: Panther Mart
cards.subtitle: Post Hall Convenience Store
cards.notes: Grab snacks, beverages, and convenience items at this Post Hall hub, which transitions to a late-night grill service after standard hours.
cards.short_summary: A central campus convenience store in Post Hall that provides late-night snacks and grill items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther Mart C-Store in Post Hall is open for late-night ordering until 12:00 midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily; accepts Panther Dollars.

cards.title: Cherry Valley Deli
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Local Deli Staple
cards.notes: Head to this legendary 24-hour deli for signature sandwiches like the 'Coyote' or 'Bindie' just a short drive from campus.
cards.short_summary: A famous 24/7 deli in West Hempstead known for its extensive menu of unique, heavy sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Cherry Valley West Hempstead is open 24/7 with fresh food, deli, and snacks every single day.
cards.source_title: Open 24 HOURS. Every single day At Cherry Valley West Hempstead
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: IHOP Williston Park
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Breakfast Run
cards.notes: Drive north to Hillside Avenue for a full breakfast menu available at any hour, a classic choice for late-night study breaks.
cards.short_summary: A reliable 24-hour pancake house located a few miles north of the Adelphi campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The IHOP location at 145 Hillside Ave in Williston Park is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: IHOP® Breakfast in Williston Park, NY on 145 Hillside Ave

cards.title: 7-Eleven Franklin Square
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Convenience Stop
cards.notes: Stop by this 24-hour convenience store on Hempstead Turnpike for quick snacks, hot food, and beverages at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store located just south of campus on a major local thoroughfare.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 850 Hempstead Turnpike in Franklin Square is open 24/7.

cards.title: Applebee's Westbury
cards.subtitle: Late Night Half-Price Apps
cards.notes: Visit this neighborhood grill for half-price appetizers starting at 9:00 PM, a popular late-night dining option for students.
cards.short_summary: A casual dining chain in Westbury known for its late-night appetizer specials and extended hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Applebee's Westbury is open until 12:00 AM and serves half-price appetizers from 9:00 PM to close.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar in Westbury, NY
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily; late-night specials begin at 9:00 PM.

cards.title: Dunkin' Nassau Blvd
cards.subtitle: Evening Coffee & Donuts
cards.notes: Grab a late-evening coffee or donut at this Nassau Boulevard location, situated conveniently near the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: A nearby coffee and donut shop that provides late-evening options for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 334 Nassau Blvd in Garden City is open until 9:00 PM daily.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 334 Nassau Blvd in Garden City

cards.title: Grand Lux Cafe
cards.subtitle: Late Night Mall Dining
cards.notes: Located at Roosevelt Field, this upscale-casual spot offers a massive menu with late-night hours on weekends.
cards.short_summary: An expansive restaurant at Roosevelt Field Mall offering late-night dining options near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Grand Lux Cafe at Roosevelt Field is open until 11:00 PM on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: American Restaurant in Garden City, New York - Grand Lux Cafe
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:00 PM on Friday and Saturday; 10:00 PM on other nights.

cards.title: Halal Munchies
cards.subtitle: Late Night Halal Platters
cards.notes: Order chicken or lamb over rice platters at this Hempstead spot, a favorite for students seeking flavorful late-night meals.
cards.short_summary: A popular halal restaurant in Hempstead offering late-night platters and sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Halal Munchies in Hempstead offers freshly prepared halal platters and is a known late-night food destination.
cards.access_notes: Open late daily; check mobile apps for current closing times.

cards.title: Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Finals Week Tradition
cards.notes: Join fellow students in Post Hall during finals week for a complimentary late-night breakfast served by university staff.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal university-hosted event providing free late-night meals to students during final exams.
cards.evidence_claim: Adelphi University hosts a Late Night Breakfast event in Post Hall from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM during finals.
cards.source_title: Late Night Breakfast - December 10, 2025 - Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Seasonal event held during finals week; typically 9:00 PM – 11:00 PM.
